title: Year-end planning — four clients
instructions: Evaluate whether each proposed strategy fits the client's situation.

rows.label: A retiree, 74, must take an RMD and gives $15,000 a year to her church; she takes the standard deduction. Strategy: a qualified charitable distribution from her IRA.
rows.explanation: A QCD counts toward the RMD and keeps the gift out of AGI, which helps a non-itemizer.

rows.label: A client in a temporary low-income year. Strategy: convert part of a traditional IRA to a Roth IRA.
rows.explanation: Conversion income is taxed at low marginal rates.

rows.label: A client wants to give stock that has fallen below her basis to her grandson. Strategy: give the shares directly.
rows.explanation: The donee can't use her loss; she should sell, take the loss and give cash.

rows.label: A client in the 0% capital gains bracket holds appreciated stock. Strategy: sell and repurchase to raise basis.
rows.explanation: Gains taxed at 0% step up basis; the wash sale rule doesn't apply to gains.

rows.label: A parent wants to shift $20,000 of interest income to her 10-year-old to save tax. Strategy: transfer bonds to the child.
rows.explanation: The kiddie tax taxes the child's unearned income above the threshold at the parent's rate.
